Full Stack Engineer

Location: Remote (Americas / EMEA)
Team: Product Engineering

About PostHog
We're building the developer platform for building successful products — analytics, session replay, feature flags, experiments, and more in one product.

What you'll do
- Own features end-to-end across our Django/Python backend and React/TypeScript frontend
- Ship product improvements used by tens of thousands of companies
- Work with a small, high-trust team; write RFCs when decisions need alignment
- Improve reliability, performance, and developer experience as you go

Must-have requirements
- Strong experience with TypeScript and modern React
- Comfortable with Python (Django or similar) or willing to ramp quickly
- Experience designing and shipping production web apps
- Clear written communication; we work asynchronously
- Product sense: you care about the user problem, not only the ticket

Nice to have
- ClickHouse, Postgres, Redis, or Kafka experience
- Prior work on analytics, experimentation, or developer tools
- Open-source contributions

Interview process typically includes an applications review, a technical screen, a paid take-home (or equivalent), and team / culture conversations. We publish how we hire in our handbook.

Backend Engineer, Verify

Location: Remote
Department: Engineering

GitLab is an open-core DevSecOps platform. The Verify stage owns CI pipelines, runners, and related reliability work that millions of developers depend on daily.

Responsibilities
- Design and implement backend features in Ruby on Rails and supporting services
- Improve pipeline performance, correctness, and observability
- Collaborate publicly in issues and merge requests; default to async written communication
- Participate in on-call and incident reviews for CI-related services

Required qualifications
- 4+ years professional backend engineering experience
- Strong skills in Ruby, Go, or Python and willingness to work primarily in Rails
- Experience with PostgreSQL (schema design, indexing, query performance)
- Familiarity with distributed systems concepts: queues, retries, idempotency, eventual consistency
- Experience with Docker-based development and CI systems

Preferred qualifications
- Prior work on CI/CD products or large-scale job execution systems
- Kubernetes operations experience
- Contributions to open source
- Experience working in a remote-only, handbook-first company

We document our hiring process and values publicly. Expect technical interviews focused on real GitLab problems, not puzzle trivia.

Senior Frontend Engineer

We're hiring someone to own our customer dashboard UI.

Required
- Expert React and TypeScript
- Strong accessibility (WCAG 2.2) practice
- Experience with design systems and component libraries
- Comfortable partnering with Product and Design

Nice to have
- Next.js App Router
- Storybook / Chromatic
- GraphQL (Apollo or urql)

You will lead frontend architecture discussions and mentor mid-level engineers.
Interview includes a UI take-home and a frontend system-design round.

Software Engineer, Payments

Location: Hybrid / Remote-flexible

Stripe builds economic infrastructure for the internet. The Payments organization works on authorization, capture, retries, and money movement used by millions of businesses.

What you'll work on
- Design and implement highly reliable services that move money correctly
- Debug subtle production issues across distributed systems
- Partner with Risk, Treasury, and Product on payment-method expansions
- Write clear design docs and participate in thoughtful code review

Minimum qualifications
- 3+ years of professional software engineering experience
- Proficiency in at least one of: Java, Go, Ruby, or TypeScript
- Experience building and operating production services
- Strong fundamentals in data structures, APIs, and relational databases
- Ability to reason about failure modes, idempotency, and consistency

Preferred qualifications
- Prior payments, fintech, or high-correctness systems experience
- Experience with event-driven architectures and queue-based workflows
- Familiarity with observability (metrics, traces, structured logging)
- Experience mentoring engineers or leading projects

We value precision, user empathy, and intellectual honesty. Expect interviews that probe real system design and debugging judgment.

Senior Software Engineer, Frontend Platform

Location: Remote (US)

Vercel enables developers to build and deploy modern web applications. Frontend Platform improves the frameworks, tooling, and product surfaces millions of developers use.

Role overview
- Build polished, accessible UI in React and TypeScript
- Improve performance: Core Web Vitals, bundling, streaming, caching
- Collaborate with Design on interaction quality and design-system consistency
- Contribute to Next.js / React ecosystem knowledge inside the company

Requirements
- Deep expertise in React and TypeScript
- Production experience with Next.js (App Router preferred)
- Strong grasp of browser performance, accessibility, and progressive enhancement
- Experience owning frontend architecture for a substantial product surface
- Excellent written communication for RFCs and design reviews

Bonus points
- Contributions to Next.js, React, or related open source
- Experience with edge runtimes, ISR/SSR tradeoffs, and CDN caching
- Design-system / component-library authorship
- Mentoring and technical leadership

Interviewing typically includes practical coding, a system or architecture discussion, and team collaboration conversations.

Full-Stack Engineer

Location: Remote (Americas)

Linear builds the issue tracking and project management tool purpose-built for high-performance teams. We care deeply about speed, craft, and opinionated product design.

You will
- Ship features across our TypeScript stack (Node, GraphQL, React)
- Obsess over latency, keyboard flows, and interaction details
- Work closely with product and design in a small engineering team
- Help maintain a high quality bar through review and technical taste

Must have
- Strong TypeScript across frontend and backend
- Experience building complex React applications with excellent UX
- Familiarity with GraphQL APIs and real-time / sync-heavy clients
- High bar for code quality, performance, and product polish
- Ability to operate independently in an async remote culture

Nice to have
- Experience with CRDTs, offline-first, or collaborative editing
- Prior work on developer tools or productivity software
- Design sensibility / ability to implement nuanced UI without pixel-pushing tickets

We hire for craft. Expect interviews that value taste and systems thinking as much as algorithm drills.

Product Manager, Growth

Location: Hybrid (San Francisco) / Remote-flexible

Notion is an AI workspace for notes, docs, wikis, and projects. Growth PM owns activation, retention, and expansion loops that help teams adopt Notion.

Responsibilities
- Define problem statements, hypotheses, and success metrics for growth experiments
- Partner with Engineering, Design, Data, and Marketing to ship and learn quickly
- Analyze funnels (SQL + product analytics) and turn insights into roadmap bets
- Write crisp specs and communicate tradeoffs to leadership
- Represent the customer with empathy — especially new teams ramping onto Notion

Must-have qualifications
- 4+ years of product management experience in B2B or consumer SaaS
- Proven ownership of activation, retention, or monetization experiments
- Strong analytical skills; SQL preferred
- Excellent written and verbal communication; comfortable with ambiguity
- Experience aligning cross-functional stakeholders without heavy process

Nice to have
- Prior work on collaboration / productivity products
- Familiarity with Amplitude, Mixpanel, or equivalent
- Technical background sufficient to discuss API and performance constraints
- Experience with AI-assisted product surfaces

Behavioral interviews emphasize prioritization under constraint, conflict resolution, and customer discovery.

Systems Engineer / SRE

Location: Remote

Cloudflare operates a global network that secures and accelerates Internet properties. Systems engineers keep edge and control-plane services reliable at massive scale.

What you'll do
- Operate and improve highly available distributed systems on our edge network
- Define SLIs/SLOs, build useful dashboards, and drive error-budget conversations
- Automate toil with solid engineering (Go, Rust, or Python — depth beats checklist breadth)
- Lead incident response and write blameless postmortems that change the system
- Partner with product engineering teams on deploy safety and capacity planning

Required
- Production experience with Linux, networking fundamentals, and large-scale services
- Infrastructure as code (Terraform or equivalent) and CI/CD for infra changes
- Hands-on observability: metrics, logs, traces; comfort with SLO/error-budget thinking
- Strong scripting/software skills in Go, Python, or Rust
- Clear communication during incidents and in written follow-ups

Preferred
- Experience with CDN, DNS, reverse proxies, or TLS termination at scale
- Kubernetes or other orchestration in production
- Chaos engineering / load testing practice
- Prior on-call ownership for customer-facing systems

We care about practical debugging judgment and systems intuition.

Machine Learning Engineer, Platform

Location: San Francisco (Hybrid)

OpenAI builds AI systems and developer platforms. ML Platform engineers make training and inference workflows reliable, measurable, and usable by research and applied teams.

Responsibilities
- Build and productionize pipelines for training, evaluation, and deployment
- Improve offline/online evaluation harnesses and experiment tracking
- Partner with researchers and product engineers on metric definitions and launch criteria
- Raise the quality bar for reliability, observability, and developer experience of ML systems

Must-have requirements
- Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals
- Experience training, evaluating, and shipping ML models or LLM application systems
- Familiarity with feature/data pipelines and warehouse concepts (SQL)
- Ability to deploy models behind APIs, batch jobs, or streaming scorers
- Clear collaboration skills with research and product partners

Nice to have
- PyTorch at scale; distributed training familiarity
- Vector search / embeddings / RAG evaluation experience
- Prior work on LLM eval harnesses, red-teaming tooling, or safety evals
- Experience operating GPU fleets or inference services

Seniority: Mid to Senior. Expect interviews covering ML systems design, coding, and cross-functional collaboration.
